Soft gold-capped blunt wooden toy needles radiate from its stitch seams. Its knot is on the round underbelly. RIGHT, an upright sinuous snake with a low flattened wedge-shaped head, no limbs, a raised S curve, long floor coil and tapering visible tail. Broken aged gold fabric mosaic adorns the snake brow, knot sewn into the exposed lower throat. Moody almost charcoal-purple patchwork mixed with slate plum in all three, finely mottled single-dye wool with brighter lilac braid. Second image sets the interior of the warm striped felt circus tent, circular center stage, ring of audience stands, strings of amber bulbs and padded stage floor made from big stitched squares. All four frames depict the same arena and costume. Each frame is viewed from a playable grounded eye-level or first person jump view, not overhead, no UI, no reticle. Keep important elements near each frame's center so the actions read when printed small. Upper left: from just inside ring, masked clown under a single amber ceiling spotlight beyond the stage; three small plush surprise boxes in three evident midair positions thrown toward camera; distinct small warm rose stitched warning halos low on arena floor at their projected landing sites, no abstract patterns. Upper right: from lower player eye level looking slightly downward just before a jump, one settled surprise box near the front center, open hinged lid and broad flat spring pad raised above it on a clearly visible textile coil; the toy feet are planted away from the box in the background, face higher in shot than the player.
